name: Pfundser Ugi's Imbiss
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pfundser Ugi’s Snack Bar in Tirol** --- **

Discover Authentic Tyrolean Flavors

** Welcome to **Pfundser Ugi’s Imbiss**, your go-to spot for hearty, traditional Tyrolean snacks in the heart of **Tirol**. Whether you're craving a quick bite after a day of hiking in the **Zillertal Alps** or need a filling meal before exploring **Innsbruck’s** historic old town, we’ve got you covered. **

Our Specialties

** - **Kaiserschmarrn** – Fluffy, caramelized shreds of pancake, dusted with powdered sugar and served with fresh fruit compote or apple sauce. - **Tiroler Gröstl** – A rustic potato pancake loaded with crispy bacon, onions, and a fried egg on top. - **Leberkäse** – Tirol’s beloved meatloaf, sliced and served with mustard, bread, or in a fresh roll. - **Käsekrainer** – Juicy grilled sausage wrapped in cheese, grilled to perfection and paired with a fresh salad or pretzels. - **Obatzda** – Creamy camembert and butter spread, mixed with paprika and served with radishes and bread. - **Apfelstrudel** – Warm, flaky pastry filled with spiced apples, cinnamon, and raisins—best enjoyed with vanilla sauce. **

Why Visit Us?

** - **Fresh & Local** – All our ingredients come straight from **Tirol’s** farms and dairies. - **Quick & Tasty** – Perfect for a fast lunch or a satisfying snack on the go. - **Cozy Atmosphere** – Step into our rustic **Tiroler** hut and enjoy your meal in a warm, inviting setting. - **Family-Owned** – Since 1987, **Pfundser Ugi’s** has been a beloved spot for locals and visitors alike. **

Location & Hours

** 📍 **Pfundser Ugi’s Imbiss** 📍 **Hauptstraße 42, 6060 Pfunds** (just outside **Innsbruck**, near the **Zillertal** entrance) ⏰ **Monday–Friday:** 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM ⏰ **Saturday:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM ⏰ **Sunday:** 12:00 PM – 6:00 PM **

Pro Tip

** Pair your meal with a **Tiroler Bier** (local beer) or a refreshing **Apfelschorle** (apple juice spritzer) for the full experience! **

Come for the Food, Stay for the Stories

** At **Pfundser Ugi’s**, every bite tells a tale of **Tirol’s** rich culinary traditions. Stop by and taste the flavors that make this region unforgettable! --- **Visit Us Today**
